Of course! Our two main models, the Plank and the Plank Luxe, both offer incredible value depending on your sleep preferences. Here’s a direct comparison to help you decide. 💡

Original Plank (All-Foam)

Best For: Those who want the absolute firmest all-foam feel with zero sink. It's ideal for back and stomach sleepers.
Type: All-foam with a high-density foam core.
Firmness: Flippable with a Firm (8/10) side and an Ultra-Firm (10/10) side.
Thickness: ~11 inches.
Cooling: Has an optional GlacioTex™ cooling cover you can add.

Plank Luxe (Hybrid)

Best For: Those who prefer a firm sleep surface but with added comfort, pressure relief, and cooling.
Type: Hybrid, combining foam with 6″ pocketed coils.
Firmness: Flippable with a Firm (7/10) side and an Ultra-Firm (9–9.5/10) side.
Thickness: ~13.25 inches.
Cooling: The coils provide standard cooling, and you can add an optional GlacioTex™ cooling top.
Added Benefits: The coils provide stronger edge support and more responsiveness.

Both mattresses come with a 120-night trial and a limited lifetime warranty. Essentially, the choice comes down to whether you prioritize the firmest possible all-foam experience (Plank) or a firm hybrid feel with more comfort and cooling features (Plank Luxe).
